master.name_en: agenesis of the corpus callosum with peripheral neuropathy
master.definition_en: Corpus callosum agenesis-neuropathy is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by severe progressive sensorimotor neuropathy beginning in infancy with resulting hypotonia, areflexia, amyotrophy and variable degrees of dysgenesis of the corpus callosum. Additional features include mild-to-severe intellectual and developmental delays, and psychiatric manifestations that include paranoid delusions, depression, hallucinations, and "autistic-like" features. Affected individuals are usually wheelchair restricted in the second decade of life and die in the third decade of life. The disease is inherited as an autosomal recessive trait.

master.definition_en: Hypertension that presents without an identifiable cause.

mechanisms: Neuronal acetylcholine receptor; alpha3/beta4 negative allosteric modulator

curated.category: 慢性心血管与血管疾病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 典型‘无声慢病杀手’：早期常无明显症状，但长期血流动力学剪切应力损伤血管内皮，数年至数十年间逐步驱动左心室肥厚（高血压性心脏病）、冠状动脉粥样硬化、脑卒中（尤其脑出血）、主动脉夹层及慢性肾衰竭；GBD 2021中‘高收缩压’作为全球第一大可改变代谢死因每年引发约1,080万全因死亡，其中高血压性心脏病直接死亡约133万例/年。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 通过低盐饮食、生活方式干预及联合使用五大类集采低价长效降压药完全可有效达标控制（<140/90或<130/80 mmHg），从而大幅降低卒中、心梗与心衰发生率；核心瓶颈不在药价而在长期服药依从性及我国仅约12%–15%的人群总体控制率。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021统计高血压性心脏病（HHD）直接死亡约133万例/年（PubMed PMID:40287533）；同时‘高收缩压’作为危险因素驱动全球约1,080万例/年总死亡（主要通过卒中、缺血性心脏病及HHD实现）

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: WHO/国家卫健委统计口径将高血压所致死亡主要拆分至脑卒中与缺血性心脏病及HHD中（未单独统计‘原发性高血压’单一死亡总数）；中国近2.45亿–2.74亿高血压患者中约2.4亿人血压未得到有效控制，为我国心脑血管疾病居首位死因的核心底座
annual_deaths_china.source: 《中国心血管健康与疾病报告2023/2024》 / PMC12955038

epidemiology.prevalence_global: WHO估计全球30–79岁成人高血压患者超12.8亿；GBD 2021高血压性心脏病年龄标化患病率约 148.3 / 10万人（PMID:40287533）

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 降压药物正迎来‘长效RNAi+靶向新通路’革命：1）靶向肝脏血管紧张素原（AGT）的siRNA药物Zilebesiran继NEJM 2023 Phase 1研究（PMID:37467498）与JAMA 2024 KARDIA-1单药2期试验后，JAMA 2025 KARDIA-2试验（PMC12120674）进一步证实联用标准口服药可提供持久平稳24小时降压；2）内皮素双受体拮抗剂Aprocitentan已获批用于难治性高血压，高选择性醛固酮合酶抑制剂（Baxdrostat/Lorundrostat）推进临床开发；3）经导管去肾交感神经术（RDN）获批临床应用；4）中国农村低钠代盐（SSaSS）与乡村医生全流程强化降压（CRHCP）3期试验已验证低成本模式可显著降全因死亡。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1）全国高血压控制率仍仅约12%–15%，无症状导致青年与农村患者漏服停药率极高；2）基层医疗机构继发性高血压（原发性醛固酮增多症、睡眠呼吸暂停等）筛查识别率低；3）血压昼夜节律波动与清晨高血压管理不够精细。

master.definition_en: An uncommon intraepithelial malignant neoplasm of eccrine or apocrine origin, arising from the vulva. It usually affects post-menopausal women. In approximately 10-20% of the cases there is an associated anorectal, or urothelial carcinoma or a skin appendage adenocarcinoma identified. It presents as a red, eczematous lesion. Microscopically, it is characterized by the presence of the typical Paget cells which are large, round cells with abundant cytoplasm and prominent nuclei.

master.definition_en: This very rare form of angioedema develops in reply to contact with vibration. In vibratory angioedema, symptoms develop within two to five minutes after contact with vibration and dissolve after about an hour. Patients with this disorder do not suffer from dermographism or pressure urticaria. Vibratory angioedema is diagnosed by holding a vibrating device such as a laboratory vortex machine against the forearm for four minutes. Speedy swelling of the whole forearm extending into the upper arm is also noted later. The principal treatment is avoidance of vibratory stimulants. Antihistamines have also been proven helpful.

master.definition_en: Mercury poisoning is caused mainly through ingestion or inhalation of any of the 3 forms of mercury, elemental, organic, and inorganic. Exposure to elemental mercury affects the pulmonary (inhalation of mercury vapors causes coughing, chills, fever, shortness of breath), dermatological (mild swelling, vesiculation, scaling, irritation, urticaria, erythema and allergic contact dermatitis accompanied by pain), and peripheral and central nervous (CNS) systems (depression, paranoia, extreme irritability, hallucinations, inability to concentrate, memory loss, hands, head, lips, tongue, jaw and eyelids tremors, weight loss, perpetually low body temperature, drowsiness, headaches, insomnia, fatigue). Exposure to inorganic mercury generally causes development of a metallic taste, local oropharyngeal pain, nausea, vomiting, bloody diarrhea, colic abdominal pain, renal dysfunction and, neurologic abnormalities; while that to organic mercury can lead to delayed neurotoxicity.

master.definition_en: A rare, congenital, non-syndromic heart malformation characterized by an abnormal attachment of the mitral chordae to both ventricles. Straddling mitral valve is usually associated with conotruncal anomalies, most commonly double outlet right ventricle or transposition of the great arteries. Overriding mitral valve is characterized by a mitral annulus committed to the two ventricular chambers, where the mitral valve is shared between the ventricles. Straddling and overriding mitral valve can occur together or in isolation.

master.definition_en: A syndrome that results from a group of infections that affect the fetus or the newborn. The group of infections includes Toxoplasma gondii, rubella, cytomegalovirus, herpes simplex virus, and other infections. The other infections include varicella-zoster virus, hepatitis B virus, human immunodeficiency virus, parvovirus B19, and syphilis. master.definition_en: An autosomal recessive disorder resulting from fragility of cerebral vessels causing an increased risk of intracranial bleeding. Some patients may have onset in utero or early infancy, with subsequent global developmental delay, spasticity, and porencephaly on brain imaging. Other patients may have normal or mildly delayed development with sudden onset of intracranial hemorrhage causing acute neurologic deterioration.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.name_en: Ileal pouch anal anastomosis related faecal incontinence
master.definition_en: A rare intestinal disorder characterized by the inability to control the passage of rectal contents (feces, gas) through the anus following ileal pouch-anal anastomosis surgery. Fecal incontinence is usually more frequent during the night than during daytime. The condition generally worsens over time, with a significant negative impact on the quality of life of the patient.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。
